deployRegistry.notes: Single shared registry for all identities (deployed once per network).

createIdentity.notes: Identity exists implicitly (every address is a DID, zero-cost). Measured: first setAttribute publishing a verification key.

updateAttribute.notes: setAttribute rotating the published key (event-only storage; DID document built off-chain from event history).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: addDelegate(veriKey) with 1-year validity. On-chain claims are not part of ERC-1056.

revoke.notes: revokeAttribute of the published key. revokeDelegate is also supported at similar cost.

transferOwnership.notes: changeOwner: rotates the controlling key of the DID (identifier itself is stable).

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared NFT contract; deployer receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and MANUFACTURER_ROLE in constructor.

createIdentity.notes: mintVehicle (manufacturer-only): mints NFT, stores VIN mapping + on-chain metadata struct + initial transfer record.

updateAttribute.notes: No key/attribute model in ERC-721. Measured closest analogue: addServiceRecord appending a metadata URI (role grant excluded as setup).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: approve(): delegates TRANSFER rights only - not a verification-key delegation or identity claim as in DID standards.

transferOwnership.notes: transferFrom: token transfer with on-chain transfer-history bookkeeping (contract overrides _update).

revoke.notes: deactivateVehicle (admin-only): marks identity inactive; token itself is not burned.

deployRegistry.notes: No shared registry in ERC-725: each identity is its own proxy-account contract. Deployment cost is counted under createIdentity.

createIdentity.notes: Per-vehicle identity contract deployment (proxy account); deployer becomes owner/management key. Paid once per identity.

updateAttribute.notes: addKey(purpose=1 MANAGEMENT, type=1 ECDSA): key rotation/addition stored in contract state.

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: addKey(purpose=3 CLAIM signer key). Full on-chain claim storage lives in the companion ERC-735 claim holder, benchmarked separately as ERC-735.

revoke.notes: removeKey: deletes key and compacts the key array (cost grows with number of stored keys).

transferOwnership.notes: transferOwnership of the identity contract to the new vehicle owner.

deployRegistry.notes: No shared registry in ERC-735: each vehicle identity is its own claim-holder contract. Deployment cost is counted under createIdentity.

createIdentity.notes: Per-vehicle claim-holder contract deployment (constructor stores VIN + vinHash, deployer becomes owner). Paid once per identity.

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: addClaim (new claim, ClaimAdded): stores full signed claim on-chain after verifying the issuer's EIP-191 signature over (identity, topic, data) via ecrecover. Delegates are not part of ERC-735.

updateAttribute.notes: No key/attribute model in ERC-735. Measured closest analogue: re-adding a claim for the same (issuer, topic) updates it in place (ClaimChanged, warm same-size rewrite of data/signature/URI).

revoke.notes: removeClaim (owner or issuer): deletes the claim struct and compacts the topic index (ClaimRemoved, storage refund applies).

transferOwnership.notes: transferOwnership of the per-vehicle claim-holder contract to the new vehicle owner.

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared multi-token credential contract; deployer receives DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and ISSUER_ROLE in constructor.

createIdentity.notes: registerVehicle (issuer-only): mints one soulbound BIRTH_CERT token, binds VIN string + vinHash mappings to the vehicle address.

updateAttribute.notes: No key/attribute model in ERC-1155. Measured closest analogue: setTokenURI per-credential-type metadata URI override (issuer-only).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: issueCredential (issuer-only): mints an INSPECTION_CERT credential token to a registered vehicle (claim analogue; delegates are not part of ERC-1155).

revoke.notes: revokeCredential (issuer-only burn) of the inspection credential. Burning the BIRTH_CERT would deregister the whole identity.

transferOwnership.notes: issuerTransferCredential of the BIRTH_CERT: re-binds VIN + registration mappings to the new vehicle address. Credentials are soulbound - holder-initiated transfers revert by design.

deployRegistry.notes: CVINMinimalEntryPoint deployment (shared infrastructure, analogous to a registry). NOTE: minimal research harness, not the canonical v0.7 EntryPoint - no bundler batching, paymasters, deposits or gas accounting.

createIdentity.notes: Per-vehicle smart-account deployment (identity creation): the account address is the stable vehicle identifier; the signing key can rotate without changing it. Direct deploy - no initCode/AccountFactory counterfactual deployment.

updateAttribute.notes: setAttribute called DIRECTLY by the owner key (ERC-725Y-flavoured attribute store, cold slot first write).

updateAttributeVia4337.notes: Same setAttribute routed as a PackedUserOperation through the EntryPoint (handleOp -> validateUserOp [ecrecover] -> execute -> self-call). Indirection overhead vs direct call: 46862 gas. EXCLUDES real-world bundler overhead (mempool, handleOps batching, paymaster, deposit/refund accounting).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: setGuardian: designates a social-recovery guardian (recovery-delegate analogue; recovery capability unique to contract accounts). No on-chain claim model in ERC-4337.

transferOwnership.notes: transferOwnership = signing-key rotation; the identity (account address) is unchanged. Guardian-driven recoverOwner measured separately (see revoke notes).

revoke.notes: setGuardian(0): revokes the recovery guardian (delegate-revocation analogue; storage clear, refund applies). ERC-4337 has no identity-level revocation - the account contract persists. Guardian recoverOwner (social recovery, new signing key installed by guardian) measured separately: 30955 gas.

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared LSP8 collection contract; deployer becomes the issuing authority (contract owner).

createIdentity.notes: mintVehicle (authority-only): mints bytes32 tokenId = keccak256(VIN) and stores the VIN in the per-token LSP2-style data store.

updateAttribute.notes: setDataForTokenId: writes a per-token ERC-725Y-style data key (TokenIdDataChanged + DataChanged events).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: Not supported by this representative LSP8 implementation: operator authorization (authorizeOperator) is not implemented, and LSP8 has no native claim model - attestations live in per-token data keys (covered by updateAttribute).

transferOwnership.notes: LSP8 5-arg transfer(from, to, tokenId, force=true, data) by the token owner. force=true skips LSP1 universal-receiver probing (hooks omitted in this implementation).

revoke.notes: revokeVehicle (issuing authority or token owner): burns the token (Transfer to zero + VehicleRevoked); tokenId ceases to exist.

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared registry (V2 = ERC-1056 base + MOBI VID I birth certificates + VID II lifecycle events); deployer becomes registry authority + authorized manufacturer.

createIdentity.notes: registerVehicleBirth (MOBI VID I birth certificate): VIN hash + encrypted VIN + cert hash + first owner. birthAttributes left empty to avoid known V1 validity-overflow bug.

updateAttribute.notes: recordLifecycleEvent (MOBI VID II, MAINTENANCE): stores full event struct + VC hash + counters on-chain. Issuer authorization excluded as setup.

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: Inherited ERC-1056 addDelegate (sigAuth, 1 year). V2-native multi-party attestEvent (claim analogue, 65-byte signature stored) measured separately: 188480 gas.

transferOwnership.notes: transferVehicleOwnership: appends odometer-stamped ownership record + ERC-1056 changeOwner. Called by current owner.

revoke.notes: revokeIdentity (inherited ERC-1056 extension): permanently flags the vehicle DID as revoked (decommissioning).

deployRegistry.notes: Single shared hybrid registry (ERC-1056 event-based identity + ERC-735 on-chain claim storage in one contract).

createIdentity.notes: Identity exists implicitly (ERC-1056 side: every address is a DID, zero-cost). Measured: first setAttribute publishing a verification key (event-only).

updateAttribute.notes: setAttribute rotating the published key (ERC-1056 side, event-only storage).

addDelegateOrClaim.notes: addClaim (ERC-735 side): verifies the issuer's raw-digest ECDSA signature via ecrecover and stores the full claim on-chain (O(1) verification thereafter). Event-only ERC-1056 addDelegate measured separately: 55175 gas.

revoke.notes: removeClaim (ERC-735 side): deletes the stored claim + topic index (storage refund applies). Event-only revokeAttribute/revokeDelegate (ERC-1056 side) also supported at ~ERC-1056 cost.

transferOwnership.notes: changeOwner (ERC-1056 side): rotates the controlling key of the DID (identifier stable).

metadata.notes: gasUsed is the exact receipt.gasUsed of a single representative transaction per operation on a fresh Hardhat in-process network. null = operation not supported by the standard (see notes). Setup transactions (role grants, issuer authorization) are excluded from operation gas. updateAttributeVia4337 exists only for ERC-4337: it is the same setAttribute routed through the EntryPoint as a UserOperation, so the delta vs updateAttribute is the 4337 indirection overhead (bundler overhead excluded).
